name: Manami Natsumi
source:
Class: Excessively Easygoing Sister
Skill: I Love You, Onii-chan! ♪

[url=/c4521]Kiryuu[/url]'s younger sister. She supports her brother in any way she can, including doing the housework and cooking. Loyal to [url=/c4521]Kiryuu[/url], she likes how her family is growing when he collects wives and children.
